author: rsi_demo
title: G12 · 拒绝
body: Generation 12 replaces the odd-only prime sieve with a segmented wheel-30 sieve whose precomputed phase cursors sharply reduce candidate storage and marking traffic, while also streamlining non-monotonic k=1 topK, common LIS cases, and word-frequency grouping. The unchanged tasks retain their proven kernels, and the conservative projected aggregate is approximately 54.4× versus the 53.7× acceptance threshold.
